messages.subject: plotting cdf
parts:
Hi Group,
I have fitted a GPCM model with 0-3 scale. I have 2 questions about it:
1) Is there a way I can plot cdf ( as opposed to pdf) for an item?
For example, for Q1 (that can be answered in the scale 0-3), when I use item plot I get the following plot. My understanding is that these are pdf of each scale value (0,1,2 or 3). Is there a way to draw cdf (that hopefully will look like s-curve) ?



2) How to interpret the a1 param in the gpcm case? as there is one differentiation (a1) param that is the same for different difficulty parameters (d0..3).  Following is a coef() output.


Thanks,
Azman Sami

messages.subject: Re: plotting cdf
parts:
On Mon, Jul 12, 2021 at 4:43 AM Azman Sami <md.azm...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Group,
I have fitted a GPCM model with 0-3 scale. I have 2 questions about it:
1) Is there a way I can plot cdf ( as opposed to pdf) for an item?
For example, for Q1 (that can be answered in the scale 0-3), when I use item plot I get the following plot. My understanding is that these are pdf of each scale value (0,1,2 or 3). Is there a way to draw cdf (that hopefully will look like s-curve) ?

It's not particularly hard to do this as it's really just a 1 - cumsum(pdf) form to build such information, but at this time the package does not have a native input to print such cdf plots. I'll consider adding it to the itemplot() function in a future release.
2) How to interpret the a1 param in the gpcm case? as there is one differentiation (a1) param that is the same for different difficulty parameters (d0..3).  Following is a coef() output.

Yes, the discrimination/slope parameter is constant across all item categories. Other models have removed this type of limitation (in many ways that's what the nominal response model does, but there are also heterogeneous GRMs too). HTH.

Phil
 

Thanks,
Azman Sami

messages.subject: Re: plotting cdf
parts:
FYI, I added the cdf variants to the itemplot() function, which can be obtained by passing type = 'threshold'. Feel free to install the dev version to try it out.

Phil
